daily_net_result_formula: ClosedTradeResult + CurrentFloatingResult + AccountAppliedCommission + AccountAppliedSwap + AccountAppliedFees (each once)
breach_rule: DailyNetResult < DailyLossFloor OR Equity < MaximumLossFloorEquity; latched for the run
near_breach_rule: projected distance to either floor <= safety buffer
daily_reset: first broker-server timestamp at or after 00:00:00 of the new broker day
news_rule: News proximity recorded; OBSERVE_ONLY; MarketStrategyResult reported separately from AccountRuleAdjustedResult
source: FundedNext official Stellar 2-Step documentation as frozen in roadmap 0B.10 (2026-09-28)
